task_completion.description: Set the simulation location to Denver, Colorado (39.74°N, 104.98°W).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the location input fields or a map marker set to Denver/39.74, -104.98.

task_completion.description: Configure the 250 kW PV system with 20° tilt, 180° azimuth, and 1.2 DC/AC ratio.
task_completion.visual_evidence: PV system parameter inputs showing 250kW capacity, 20 degree tilt, and 180 degree azimuth.

task_completion.description: Input the utility rates: $22/kW-month demand charge and $0.085/kWh energy charge.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Utility rate editor or billing input screen showing $22/kW and $0.085/kWh values.

task_completion.description: Run simulations for three battery configurations (100kWh/50kW, 200kWh/100kW, 400kWh/100kW) using peak shaving.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Simulation logs, progress bars, or a results table listing three distinct battery size scenarios.

task_completion.description: Calculate or display the demand charge savings for the configurations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A results dashboard or report showing 'Demand Charge Savings' or 'Utility Bill Reduction' values.

task_completion.description: Evaluate and compare the NPV and payback periods for the three configurations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A summary table or final report comparing NPV and Payback Period across Config A, B, and C.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must evaluate 3 configurations. Valid results should fall within these ranges: Demand savings between $5,000 and $120,000; NPV between -$500,000 and $500,000; Payback period between 2.0 and 30.0 years. The site must be Denver (39.74, -104.98).
